definitions.explanation: A device used to carry out a particular function, especially in manual work.

examples.japanese: {工具|こうぐ}を{使|つか}って{修理|しゅうり}した。
{工具|こうぐ}はどこにありますか。
{電気|でんき}{工具|こうぐ}は{危険|きけん}だから{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful because power tools are dangerous.

notes:
{工具|こうぐ} refers to tools used for manual work, construction, or repair.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {工具|こうぐ}を{使|つか}う: to use tools
- {工具|こうぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to prepare tools
- {電動|でんどう}{工具|こうぐ}: power tools

COMPOUNDS:
- {工具|こうぐ}{箱|ばこ}: toolbox
- {工具|こうぐ}セット: tool set
- {大工|だいく}{道具|どうぐ}: carpentry tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {道具|どうぐ}: tool, instrument (broader meaning, includes household items)
- {器具|きぐ}: utensil, apparatus (often for specific purposes)
- {用具|ようぐ}: equipment, supplies

NOTE:
{工具|こうぐ} specifically implies tools for construction, repair, or technical work, while {道具|どうぐ} is more general.
